builds.name: Reference: Tempo and pursuit
builds.goal: Reference for Bard: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A roaming utility champion who uses chimes and portals to choose skirmishes, with meep attacks and conditional stuns controlling their start. At fixed chimes, compare meep-assisted attacks with roaming rescue value. Test meep splash/on-hit interaction and portal timing rather than assuming infinite chimes. Movement tools and compatible control marks test coordinated pursuit or escape.
testPlan: Kit question for Bard: At fixed chimes, compare meep-assisted attacks with roaming rescue value. Test meep splash/on-hit interaction and portal timing rather than assuming infinite chimes.

Start with the early core (Support quest, Shurelya or Mandate according to the kit) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use real support income and keep the quest/vision slot.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Movement tools and compatible control marks test coordinated pursuit or escape. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Bard fires a missile which will slow the first enemy struck, and continue onward. If it strikes a wall, it will stun the initial target; if it strikes another enemy, it will stun them both. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Mandate needs eligible control and allied follow-up; speed is not guaranteed damage.

The route fails Bard's stated kit question: At fixed chimes, compare meep-assisted attacks with roaming rescue value. Test meep splash/on-hit interaction and portal timing rather than assuming infinite chimes.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility. Also record allies lost while spending on personal damage.
tradeoffs: Mandate needs eligible control and allied follow-up; speed is not guaranteed damage.
Full cost 10,600 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Support quest, Shurelya or Mandate according to the kit. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Begin with the actual support quest item; Celestial Opposition is earned by transformation, not directly bought as a 400-gold legendary. Keep buying vision.
Imperial Mandate, Redemption, Mikael's Blessing are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.hypothesis: A roaming utility champion who uses chimes and portals to choose skirmishes, with meep attacks and conditional stuns controlling their start. At fixed chimes, compare meep-assisted attacks with roaming rescue value. Test meep splash/on-hit interaction and portal timing rather than assuming infinite chimes. AP-supported attacks and Nashor may create a second damage route. This is intentionally experimental; abandon it if its lost utility or durability exceeds the damage/access gained.
testPlan: Kit question for Bard: At fixed chimes, compare meep-assisted attacks with roaming rescue value. Test meep splash/on-hit interaction and portal timing rather than assuming infinite chimes.

Start with the early core (Nashor, then Rageblade) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: AP-supported attacks and Nashor may create a second damage route. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Bard fires a missile which will slow the first enemy struck, and continue onward. If it strikes a wall, it will stun the initial target; if it strikes another enemy, it will stun them both. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Lower physical attack damage and limited health; verify the kit's AP/on-hit behavior first.

tradeoffs: Lower physical attack damage and limited health; verify the kit's AP/on-hit behavior first.
Full cost 16,750 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Experimental package: plausible mechanics are not proof of strength or novelty.
buyOrder: Nashor, then Rageblade. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Zhonya's Hourglass are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
